contract.forecast_horizon: one next completed bar of the selected timeframe
contract.sample_and_forecast_stride: one bar; every asset, every interval; no abstention

training.sampling: uniform without replacement, independent of labels, all eight assets retained at each selected time
training.weighting: uniform nonflat outcomes of both signs

contract.feature_lookbacks: 18/48 completed native bars, volume 42 preceding native bars; durations therefore vary with timeframe
contract.metric_primary: per asset: correct up/down predictions divided by all intervals; exact zero movement counts as incorrect for either binary prediction
contract.metric_secondary: per asset: correct divided by nonflat intervals; balanced accuracy and directional recalls

statistics.simultaneous_method: one-sided centered bootstrap max-t for 384 model/timeframe/asset paired differences against fixed random coin
